mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) has nephrotoxic potential that may be increased by lopinavir/ritonavir combination, which can impair renal function; additionally, lopinavir may inhibit amikacin renal clearance through CYP3A4 pathways affecting drug metabolism.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, BUN, and amikacin levels closely; adjust amikacin dosing based on renal function and therapeutic drug monitoring; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative antibiotics if renal impairment develops.
